column7: New high-gain distortion introduced in February 2023; designed from scratch with multiple gain stages, 3-band active EQ, dual boost section, three operating modes and X-Gate noise gate/crossover function.
column10: Three-mode architecture, X-Gate, dual boost controls and Pre-Tone make this a strong external/function identifier; preserve it as a distinct DSM & Humboldt product rather than a Simplifier-derived clone.

column7: Fortin's first dedicated distortion pedal, introduced in October 2023 from the discontinued NATAS amp platform. Cascading gain stages, active 3-band EQ, Kill boost, Girth and Grind controls, and Mid Shape scoop/hump switching define the pedal.
column10: Preserve the pedal as a NATAS amplifier-to-pedal lineage, not as a generic high-gain box. Current manufacturer documentation confirms USA manufacture, relay bypass and the unusual 600mA startup requirement.

column7: First signature model from TWA and ground-up collaboration with Susumu Tamura. Reworks the 1981 SD-9 Sonic Distortion architecture for Scott Henderson, with improved bass/lower mids, greater output and optional 18V operation; made in USA.
column10: Signature collaboration, Tamura authorship, optional 18V operation and the two documented faceplate treatments are high-value identity markers. Keep SH9 distinct from Maxon SSD-9 and original SD-9 lineage.

column7: 2023 ROSS revival product manufactured at JHS Pedals in Kansas City. Op-amp hard-clipping distortion with soft-touch bypass and a two-setting mode switch; JHS describes a new ROSS-era platform with multiple classic ROSS circuits.
column10: Treat this as a 2023 ROSS/JHS product identity and reissue-family record, separate from vintage ROSS branding and from other ROSS models. The marketed brand and physical manufacturing entity remain distinct.

column7: Announced October 2023 as a UAFX amp-emulation pedal recreating Plexi-era British tones, with three amp/sound variants and boost/footswitch functions. Initial Lion firmware release was v1.1.5 in September 2023; v1.1.6 added Ghost Notes and Bright Cap mods in October 2023.
column10: Model identity includes the Lion '68 hardware plus firmware state. Preserve firmware changes separately from a hardware generation; current UA release notes provide a clean firmware chronology.

column7: 2023 collaboration between Poly Effects and Josh Smith. Two analog gain channels with selectable clipping on Channel A, JFET amp-style gain and resonant filters on Channel B, touch-sensitive sliders, MIDI control and preset morphing.
column10: The touch-slider surface, two-channel architecture, selectable diodes, MIDI, presets and analog-audio/digital-control split are strong identification markers. Do not collapse the product into a conventional analog overdrive category.
